text.en:
On Weapon Kill against an enemy affected by a Void Debuff:
Grants <title Void Overshield [VoidOS] /> for 8 seconds.

Most weaken effects aside from Divinity can also activate it.

enhanced (
#e Buff Duration is increased to 10 seconds.
)

title VoidOS (
A 45 HP Void Overshield that provides 75% incoming damage resistance against PVE combatants.
Works wil all Void Overshield synergies.
)
text.zh-chs:
武器击杀受虚空负面效果影响的敌人时：
获得一个 <title 虚空覆盖护盾 [VoidOS] /> ，持续 8 秒。

大多数“虚弱”效果都可以触发该特性（神性除外）.

enhanced (
#e 护盾持续时间增加到 8 秒。
)

title VoidOS (
一个 45 血量的虚空覆盖护盾，对 PVE 敌人时提供 75% 的伤害抵抗。可触发和虚空覆盖护盾相关的所有效果（星象碎片等）。
)

text.en:
On Weapon Kill against an enemy affected by a Void Debuff:
Grants a 45 HP Void Overshield for #e${8+#d} seconds.

Weaken effects other than the one provided by Divinity can also activate it.

enhanced (
var d = 2
#e Overshield Duration is increased to by 2 seconds.
)
